title: Philippines has enough natural fibers for textile growth—DA

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines already has the raw materials and market demand needed to grow its textile industry, but developing its processing capacity remains crucial to turning these resources into higher-value products, according to the Department of Agriculture’s (DA) fiber industry chief.
